h1: Build your app idea as a React Native MVP
overview: An MVP is the smallest app that can prove your idea. We start with a short call to cut your feature list down to the one journey that matters, then build only that, on iOS and Android from one codebase. You get a working app on your own phone to share with testers, simple usage tracking and a plain list of what to build next, based on what you learn.

faq: What is the difference between an MVP and a full app?
An MVP does one job well and leaves out everything else. It is built to answer a question, such as whether people will use or pay for the idea, before you spend on a full product.
Can the MVP grow into the full product later?
Yes. We build on the same React Native setup you would use for a full app, with clean code and your own repository, so later features are added rather than rebuilt.
Do I need a backend for my MVP?
Not always. Basic uses local data. Standard and Premium use a ready-made service such as Firebase or Supabase, which keeps cost and build time low. We pick with you during the planning call.
Who owns the code and the idea?
You do. The code goes in your repository, the accounts are yours and we can sign a simple confidentiality note if you want one before you share details.
